emergence.summary: A single-gene SERPING1 loss-of-function. C1-inhibitor (a serpin) is the principal brake on the contact (kallikrein-kinin) system, inhibiting plasma kallikrein and activated factor XII. When SERPING1 is deficient (type I, low C1-INH) or dysfunctional (type II, normal-level but inactive C1-INH), the kallikrein-kinin cascade is disinhibited, so bradykinin is OVER-produced -> the bradykinin burden is driven UP, causing recurrent bradykinin-mediated angioedema attacks. Read as a released serpin BRAKE on the kallikrein-bradykinin cascade (C1-INH brakes it; LOF releases it -> bradykinin UP). Molecularly this is a SERPIN loss like alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency (SERPINA1) -- the same protein family failing -- but where A1AT is read on the protective-antiprotease-LEVEL axis (DOWN), hereditary angioedema's defining axis is the downstream bradykinin OVER-production (UP), so it joins the axis-UP toxic-over-production class. The kit re-derives BOTH approved arms: RESTRAIN the over-active downstream cascade (plasma-kallikrein inhibitors lanadelumab / ecallantide / berotralstat; bradykinin B2-receptor antagonist icatibant for acute attacks) AND RESTORE the serpin brake by replacement (C1-esterase-inhibitor concentrate). The gamma read is of the SERPING1 locus switch STRUCTURE; the coding / regulatory lesions are outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: SERPING1 encodes C1-inhibitor, the serpin that restrains plasma kallikrein and activated factor XII (and C1). As a BRAKE on the contact / kallikrein-kinin cascade, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> plasma kallikrein cleaves high-molecular-weight kininogen unchecked -> bradykinin accumulates and raises vascular permeability. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding / regulatory lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the BRADYKININ BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it. (Same serpin family as SERPINA1 / A1AT, but the defining axis here is the downstream over-production rather than a protective-level loss.)

falsifiers.claim: SERPING1 LOF (released serpin brake) raises the bradykinin burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: a SERPING1 deficiency allele that LOWERED bradykinin generation / contact-system activation would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: cleaved high-molecular-weight kininogen / bradykinin generation by SERPING1 genotype (or during attacks)

falsifiers.claim: restraining the cascade (kallikrein inhibition / B2 blockade) or restoring C1-INH is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if plasma-kallikrein inhibition, B2-receptor blockade, or C1-INH replacement RAISED or failed to lower bradykinin / attack frequency, the restrain lever sign is wrong
